Subject: Novus RFI — SOC 2 gap/usage call

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for the quick overview last week. NovusBank's security team asked for a short bridge call this week to run through a SOC 2 alignment checklist and to confirm which artifacts Redwood can provide without additional work. High-level goals: confirm scope (control boundaries for hosted API), get a list of deliverables and owners, and agree on a deadline to include in our RFI response.

Can you and someone from security join tomorrow at 10:30am PT? If not, propose an alternate time.

Thanks,
Tom Patel
Director, Third-Party Risk — NovusBank
Tom.Patel@novusbank.com

Tom — thanks for flagging. We can do 10:30am PT tomorrow. Marissa (security & compliance) and I will join; looping Karthik for any exec-level clarifications. Agenda suggestion:

- Scope confirmation: hosted API + dedicated customer data controls
- Inventory of SOC 2 artifacts and expected delivery windows
- Any controls that require engineering changes or formal exceptions
- Next steps and deadlines for the RFI submission

From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Patel <tom.patel@novusbank.com>
Cc: Emily Rhodes <emily.rhodes@novusbank.com>; Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Meeting notes: SOC 2 bridge call — actions attached

Tom/Emily — great to meet. Notes + actions below (summary from the 10:30 call):

1) Scope: Novus will evaluate Redwood's Hosted API offering. Controls of interest: logical access, change management, encryption in transit & at rest, logging/retention, incident response, and vendor management.

2) Deliverables Redwood will provide by 2027-04-12 (EOD PT):
   - 1-page SOC 2 summary (what's in scope, auditor, last report date) — owner: Jasmine (attached)
   - Control mapping CSV linking Novus questions to Redwood controls/SOC 2 section — owner: Marissa (attached)
   - Network diagram showing VPC/subnet boundary for Hosted API — owner: Infra (attached network-diagram-v2.png)
   - Redaction note: any customer-specific logs are not retained in hosted product by default; we documented options.

3) Open items that need internal coordination:
   - Marissa: confirm whether RDC-managed KMS key usage is documented in our SOC 2 narrative (Novus asked). If not, supply clarifying text.
   - Karthik: approve a limited customer-facing statement about data residency options for the RFI.

4) Novus asks for proof-of-controls artifacts only where available (policy excerpts, log retention screenshots, SOC 2 index). They won't accept raw production logs.

Next steps: Jasmine will upload the SOC 2 summary, Marissa will upload the control-mapping CSV, and Infra will share the network diagram to the shared Drive link below. We'll confirm with Novus once items are uploaded.

Thanks — Jasmine

---
Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf; control-matrix-novus-template.csv; network-diagram-v2.png
Shared link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cRedwood/Novus-RFI

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com>; Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 7 Apr 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: Novus artifact pack — owners & quick clarifications

Jasmine/Karthik — following the call, I'm drafting the control mapping. Quick notes and asks for the artifact pack I'll upload to the Drive: 

- SOC 2 summary: done (Jasmine's PDF).
- Control mapping: I'll map Novus questionnaire IDs to our SOC 2 sections and note which artifacts exist vs. which require redaction or a narrative instead.
- KMS usage: Ops confirms we use a Redwood-managed KMS for hosted keys; however, we do not export key material. Karthik — can you sign off on this wording to include in the RFI: "Redwood uses a managed KMS for encryption at rest; key material is not shared with customers and key rotation is performed on a vendor-managed schedule."
- Evidence types we'll include: policy excerpts (PDF), SOC 2 index page (PDF), screenshots of retention config (PNG), and the network diagram. We will not provide production log exports.

Timeline ask: Can leadership approve the KMS wording by EOD today so we can include it in the artifact pack and send to Novus tomorrow morning?

Marissa Cole
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

From: Tom Patel <tom.patel@novusbank.com>

Subject: Re: Meeting notes: SOC 2 bridge call — actions attached

Jasmine/Marissa/Karthik — thanks for the notes and rapid turnaround. We received the Drive folder and the three artifacts you uploaded. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

- The SOC 2 summary looks good; auditor/date present.
- Control mapping: we see your mapping, but please add a short "evidence provided" column next to each control mapping row indicating the file name (e.g., SOC2-index.pdf, policy-ops.pdf).
- KMS statement: acceptable as written — Novus security will include that language in our third-party memo.

If you can add the evidence-file column by EOD tomorrow we'll mark the RFI section as complete. Appreciate the responsiveness.

Regards,
Tom
Director, Third-Party Risk — NovusBank
